entities.summary: Anna Angelica Ulrika Roos is a Swedish weightlifter, who competed in the 58 kg category and represented Sweden at international competitions. She participated in the women's 58 kg event at the 2016 Summer Olympics. She competed at European Weightlifting Championships most recently at the 2016 European Weightlifting Championships.
